scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run start -w apps/web" "npm run start -w apps/api"
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:stock-ledger:integration -w apps/api && npm run test:purchase-order-receiving:integration -w apps/api && npm run test:serialized-assets:integration -w apps/api
